explanation: I searched Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for isIso criteria that test against Spec of rings, for detecting or separating families of affine schemes, and for functor-of-points statements. I found nothing that matches. The closest general result is CategoryTheory.isIso_iff_yoneda_map_bijective in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Yoneda.lean, but it needs bijectivity for every test object. This theorem needs it only for Spec of a commutative ring, so a proof from that lemma would have to reduce to affine test schemes through a detecting argument, and that is not a one- or two-line derivation. I found no Mathlib analogue of the library's isDetecting_isAffine.
